verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-002 [witness: verification:authorization_guard_client_portal].
statements: INV-002: roles and capabilities are never read from request data; capability sets are static rules per principal type
verdicts.why: Forged staff roles and producer scope claims are rejected in favor of persisted values, while disallowed administrator, operator, and viewer capabilities are rejected according to static principal rules.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-005 [witness: verification:end_to_end_walkthrough_client_portal]; INV-005, INV-006 [witness: verification:authorization_guard_client_portal]; INV-006 [witness: verification:staff_identity_uow_client_portal]; INV-006 [witness: verification:service_identity_consumer_uow_client_portal].
statements: INV-005: a revoked grant, credential, viewer, or session blocks the next authorization check immediately, per the revocation cascade table
INV-006: a suspended or disabled staff account and a disabled service principal have no valid sessions or usable credentials
verdicts.why: The check detects revoked staff/viewer sessions, revoked viewer/producer grants, revoked viewers, suspended or disabled staff, and a disabled service principal. It does not exercise revoked credentials or prove that sessions and credentials are invalidated by a revocation cascade immediately after a previously successful check.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-029 [witness: verification:authorization_guard_client_portal]; INV-029 [witness: verification:service_identity_consumer_uow_client_portal].
statements: INV-029: a producer import is authorized for the target project per scope_mode and grants before content validation
verdicts.why: The check asserts authorization under persisted GRANTED_PROJECTS and ALL_PROJECTS scope modes and active versus missing or revoked grants. It supplies no import content or validation hook, so it does not assert that authorization occurs before content validation.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-007 [witness: verification:authorization_guard_client_portal].
statements: INV-007: viewer capabilities are read-only; a viewer can never mutate portal data or access management
verdicts.why: A viewer requesting the mutating photo-management capability is rejected, which asserts a read-only restriction in that case. The check does not attempt viewer access management or cover all portal mutation paths.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-001, INV-017, PLAT-REG-003 [witness: verification:authorization_guard_client_portal]; INV-004 [witness: verification:staff_identity_uow_client_portal].
statements: INV-001: every project-scoped operation passes the guard sequence: valid session, active principal, project access, required capability, Registry lifecycle policy; first failure wins
INV-004: authentication flows never reveal account or viewer existence; auth failures never expose project data

INV-017: an operator may access a project only through one active StaffProjectAssignment; revocation blocks the next project-scoped authorization check immediately; current administrators derive project scope from the single administrative area policy
PLAT-REG-003: a linked mutation succeeds only after server-side typed validation reports the same UUID as active
verdicts.why: The check exercises the guard stages, active and revoked staff assignments, assignment-free administrator scope, and active-versus-archived mutation behavior, including a revoked producer grant taking precedence over archived lifecycle handling. It does not assert non-enumerating authentication or absence of project-data disclosure, and it does not test a Registry response carrying a different UUID, so INV-004 and the same-UUID part of PLAT-REG-003 remain unasserted.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: PLAT-REG-006 [witness: verification:authorization_guard_client_portal]; PLAT-REG-006 [witness: verification:derived_views_uow_client_portal].
statements: PLAT-REG-006: the portal stores no Registry snapshot as current truth; live context is fetched through the gateway; archived context stays readable but grants no mutation permission
verdicts.why: The check asserts that archived Registry context remains readable and that mutation is rejected. Because the Registry boundary is substituted and portal storage is not inspected for cached snapshots, it does not assert live gateway fetching or the absence of a stored Registry snapshot as current truth.
